name: A group of figures, and a figure carrying a basket on his shoulder
summary: Sketches of a huddled group of Chinese figures, with a straw parasol above, and another figure carrying a basket on his shoulder. The shorthand refers apparently to a dining appointment with the Fearons, a British merchant family resident in Macau.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
